critical_code_review_comments: QuickEditAffiliate UX is clean: input replaces pill while editing, Escape cancels, save validates via isValidHttpUrl, FLAGSHIP guard uses window.confirm — all paths exercised and pass.

Affiliate filter 'Not set' currently counts the flagship row too (since its DB affiliate_url is empty). The UI shows 'Flagship' pill for keystone via slug override, but the filter treats it as not-set. Either is defensible, but consider deciding which semantics you want — minor consistency note, not a bug.
Partial PUT (model_dump(exclude_unset=True)) verified safe: sending only {affiliate_url} preserves title, price, priority_order — exactly what quick-edit needs.
Backend list sort [('priority_order', 1), ('category', 1), ('order', 1)] returns the strategic top-8 in the expected exact order — confirmed in both pytest and the live admin table.
Modal URL validation produces both an inline red 'Must start with https' AND a green 'Valid' marker — good real-time UX feedback.
Star pill (#1–#8) only renders for priority_order < 999 as designed; verified visually on keystone (#1) through mega-fitness-bundle (#8).
